name: Nijuushiki
source:
A boy and a girl make a promise to meet again someday. However, years later, he finds himself forgetting this promise until he is reminded by a mysterious girl in his dream. This prompts him to return to his childhood town, Ootsuki, to recollect his lost memories using his ability to glimpse into the past.

[Condensed from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221003055103/http://gyokuro.nekome.net/nijusiki/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩和一个女孩许诺有一天会再次见面。然而多年后，他发现自己忘记了这个承诺，直到梦中一个神秘女孩提醒他。这促使他回到儿时的小镇大月，利用自己窥视过去的能力来回忆失去的记忆。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221003055103/http://gyokuro.nekome.net/nijusiki/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
